{{Quote|To Khomm, where our society has remained the same for centuries. Showing them that I am changed-that I have become a Jedi Knight-will shake them up. I believe they need to be reawakened.|[[Dorsk 81]]|<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>}}
'''Khomm''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Khomm system/Legends|Khomm system]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with wide blue [[Ocean/Legends|seas]], great land masses, and an abundance of [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]. It was the home planet to the [[Khommite/Legends|Khommites]] and the [[Khommite strider/Legends|Khommite striders]].

==Description==
{{Quote|We have molded our city to be the way we want it, and we've maintained it that way. Everything is numbered and cataloged, and Khomm is a stable, understandable place. Our citizens are happy and content here.|[[Kaell 116]]|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
[[File:Khommite2.jpg|thumb|left|125px|A Khommite.]]
The Khommites possessed a culture of conformity, with a society that had remained unchanged for nearly a millennium. They decided they had reached the pinnacle of their civilization in [[990 BBY]], so life on the planet remained static. Through the [[Khomm Central Population Planning]], all of the citizens of Khomm were [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of previous generations. A clone of each person of each subsequent generation was created to ensure the contiguous continuation of their [[Species/Legends|species]].

The cities on Khomm were mathematically perfect grids, with square housing and gardens, all preplanned. The animal population of Khomm, including the [[Khommite strider/Legends|Khommite strider]], was also genetically controlled by the Khommites. It was said that when a visitor landed on Khomm, its dullness could literally make one crazy.

==History==
{{Quote|I'm the only person in Khomm's recent memory who has done anything... unpredictable.|Dorsk 81|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
At the time of the [[Galactic War]], the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] studying on Khomms' [[Academy|academies]] made astonishing progress in the field of [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Seeking Perfection}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Khomm remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="RC:TC" /> However, war-time cloning restrictions were difficult for the Khommites to live with.<ref name="Odds">{{InsiderCite|87|Odds}}</ref>

After his graduation from the [[Chandrilan Academy of Sciences]], [[Shi'ido]] scientist [[Borborygmus Gog]] infiltrated the reclusive cloner ranks of Khomm to learn from them.

One Khommite, [[Dorsk 81]], left Khomm to study at [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] because he discovered his [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]], doing something that generations before him did not do.<ref name="Darksaber" />

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] ordered an [[Attack on Khomm|attack]] on Khomm, when it was discovered that Dorsk 81 and [[Kyp Durron]] had visited the planet. [[Dorsk 80]], Dorsk 81's predecessor, wished him to return to his old job, but 81 was simply trying to warn Khomm of the impending attack. Refusing to listen, the Khommites did nothing. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ivan Cronus]] carried out Daala's order with [[Crimson Command]], devastating the planet and its population, forcing the Khommites to do something they had not done in centuries&mdash;adapt.<ref name="Darksaber" />

It is unknown what became of Khomm after the attack, though it is known that at least one of Dorsk 81's clones, [[Dorsk 82]] came to train at the Jedi Praxeum.

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Khomm in the Farfin sector, a misspelling of the true [[Farrfin sector/Legends|Farrfin sector]], of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]], not to be confused with the Deep Core.
